project: AI-Based Smart Vehicle Insurance Claim Assessment System

tasks.title: Database Schema, Seed Data, and Storage Layer
tasks.description: Implement PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy models for vehicle tiers, part catalog, rate matrix, claims, line items, overrides, and photo hashes. Build seed script with realistic Indian automotive rate matrix data. Implement S3/MinIO storage client with local filesystem fallback.
acceptance_criteria: SQLAlchemy models defined for vehicle_tier, part_catalog, rate_matrix, claims, claim_photos, claim_line_items, claim_overrides, photo_hash_store
Seed script successfully loads 3 vehicle tiers (HATCHBACK, SEDAN, SUV), 9 standard parts, and rate matrix rows
Storage client supports put_object, get_object, and local dev fallback
Database tests pass verifying relationships and seed queries

tasks.title: Fix: Replace passlib bcrypt wrap bug with native bcrypt hashing in security.py
tasks.description: Passlib 1.7.4 fails on bcrypt 5.x due to 72-byte test in detect_wrap_bug. Switch to direct bcrypt hashing in backend/app/core/security.py.
acceptance_criteria: Direct bcrypt hashing handles password hashing and verification without passlib error
Seed script runs without cryptographic initialization error

tasks.title: Computer Vision Inference & Mask Fusion Engine (Module 1)
tasks.description: Implement standalone ONNX Runtime inference wrappers for Model 1 (Vehicle Parts, 9 classes) and Model 2 (Damage Types, 6 classes). Implement fuse_masks() computing intersection_area / part_area, severity grading (MINOR, MODERATE, SEVERE), and UNATTRIBUTED damage detection. Build visual overlay generator.
acceptance_criteria: Model 1 and Model 2 run independent inference on 640x640 letterboxed inputs
fuse_masks() accurately calculates intersection_area / part_area and maps to severity bands using DAMAGE_TYPE_WEIGHT
Damage outside parts flagged as UNATTRIBUTED
Unit tests pass for synthetic masks covering minor, moderate, severe, and unattributed conditions
Visual overlay generation produces annotated PNGs with part and damage contours

tasks.title: Cost Estimation Engine & Decision Engine (Modules 2 & 3)
tasks.description: Implement deterministic cost calculation looking up rate_matrix. Implement Decision Engine evaluating rules E1 through E9, strict auto-approval whitelist, and auditable decision reasons.
acceptance_criteria: Cost calculation strictly applies repair-vs-replace rule (REPLACE if SEVERE, crack, shatter, or zero repair base)
Deductible applied deterministically: max(subtotal - deductible, 0)
Missing rate row triggers E8 escalation without crashing
Individual unit tests for each rule E1 through E9 and clean AUTO_APPROVED scenario
All decision tests pass with 100% rule coverage

tasks.title: Photo Validation & Fraud Heuristics Pipeline (Module 5)
tasks.description: Implement Laplacian variance blur detection, vehicle presence check, perceptual hashing (imagehash.phash) duplicate detection with Hamming distance, and EXIF timestamp/GPS plausibility checks. Combine into additive explainable fraud score.
acceptance_criteria: Blurry images (variance < threshold) correctly rejected (triggers E9)
Vehicle presence validator checks vehicle area in frame
Duplicate photo check detects identical and recompressed photos from other claims (triggers E7)
EXIF checker flags timestamp discrepancies while treating missing GPS as soft signal
Unit tests pass for blur, duplicate, and EXIF scenarios

tasks.title: Fix: Test isolation for photo hash store in test_photo_validation.py
tasks.description: Perceptual hash collision across test cases due to deterministic synthetic pattern. Use unique noise pattern per test case or clean database fixture.
acceptance_criteria: Test cases in test_photo_validation.py run with isolated hashes
All photo validation and fraud scoring tests pass

tasks.title: FastAPI Core Gateway & BackgroundTasks Async Pipeline (Module 4)
tasks.description: Build Core Gateway with JWT auth (policyholder, surveyor, admin roles), claim submission endpoint, async background orchestration pipeline (photo validation -> CV inference -> fusion -> cost calculation -> decision -> DB update), claim retrieval, and surveyor override endpoint with audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/claims/submit accepts incident payload and photos, returns 202 SUBMITTED
BackgroundTasks processes claim to ASSESSED or SURVEYOR_REVIEW status
GET /api/v1/claims/{id} returns full assessment with line items and E1-E9 evaluation
POST /api/v1/claims/{id}/override records surveyor changes in claim_overrides table
POST /api/v1/claims/{id}/decision finalizes claim to APPROVED or REJECTED
Integration tests pass for complete submit-to-decision lifecycle

tasks.title: Fix: Pass detected parts to photo validator and harmonize Decimal assertions in API test
tasks.description: Orchestrator called photo validator before CV parts detection resulting in vehicle coverage failure on synthetic test images. In test_claims_api.py, float comparison against Decimal string failed.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator runs part detection or passes parts to validator to prevent false E9 triggers
Decimal comparisons in test_claims_api.py convert strings to float/Decimal
Full test_claims_api.py test suite passes

tasks.title: Surveyor Review Portal & Policyholder Frontend UI
tasks.description: Develop React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS web portal with claim submission wizard, surveyor triage queue, interactive image annotation viewer with mask overlays, editable line-item cost table, fraud signal indicators, and override submission modal.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive, modern UI running via Vite
Claim list view with status badges, fraud alerts, and filter by status/date
Detailed inspection view showing original photo, AI mask overlays, and detection confidence
Editable line items table with dynamic total recalculation
Surveyor override and decision submission wired to backend API
Policyholder claim submission form tested with photo upload

tasks.title: End-to-End Verification, Test Suites & System Demonstration
tasks.description: Execute comprehensive end-to-end integration tests across all modules. Verify edge cases (E1-E9 triggers, multi-part damage, severe shatter, duplicate fraud, missing rate row). Provide demonstrator script showcasing the complete system flow.
acceptance_criteria: Full pytest test suite runs and passes with zero failures
Demonstrator script validates full lifecycle with real sample claim data
Complete system documentation and walkthrough created
